description: This Java class 'ObjeniousProvider' implements the 'LoraProvider' interface, providing methods to extract device IDs, payloads, message types, and identifying the provider name and path prefix for Objenious-specific LoRaWAN messages within the Eclipse Hono framework.

classes.name: ObjeniousProvider
classes.description: A LoRaWAN provider with API for Objenious, implementing 'LoraProvider' to handle message parsing and identification specific to Objenious within the Eclipse Hono project.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the URL path prefix associated with Objenious.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts the device ID from the JSON message, specifically the 'deveui' field within 'device_properties'.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Retrieves the payload, assumed to be in the 'payload_cleartext' field of the JSON message.

methods.name: extractMessageType
methods.description: Determines the type of LoRa message ('join', 'uplink', 'downlink', or unknown) and maps it to the corresponding 'LoraMessageType' enum.
